name: Jun Najiteka
source:
The name can be changed. A man with silver eyes and long silver hair.
He is called the "Silver Wolf." He lost his memory and lived as a soldier to make a living. One day, he is suddenly ordered to go to the city of the heavenly maidens...

[Translated from[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
